name: Eva Di Pierro
title: Executive presence coach and leadership development specialist
profile: Eva is an executive presence coach and leadership development specialist with more than 15 years' experience working with CEOs, founders and senior executives across Europe, the United States and Asia. A certified Somatic Experiencing Practitioner with advanced training in developmental psychology and Jungian coaching, she helps leaders build the composure, clarity and authority that underpin performance under pressure. Her long-term clients include the president of an $8 billion US corporation and the CEO of a leading finance and capital markets company.

career.role: Executive presence coach and leadership mentor
bullets: Coaches CEOs and senior decision-makers on presence, composure and communication in high-stakes settings
Methodology grounded in Somatic Experiencing, developmental psychology and Jungian coaching
Delivers one-to-one executive presence and leadership coaching for ISOC clients
Works with individual leaders on stress regulation, resilience and communication, using certified body-based coaching methods
Opened and ran three language training centres in Ascoli Piceno, San Benedetto del Tronto and Teramo, leading staff selection, training and business-to-business sales
President of the Confindustria Ascoli women's committee from 2011
Restructured the centre to franchise standards and returned it to profit
